target: Setback correctness, data side: scripts/validate_dcp_setbacks.py — a deterministic semantic validator for dcp_setback_controls (catches values mislabelled vs their source clause) + offline unit tests + a baseline-ratchet database test. Companion to the constraint_arithmetic._get_dcp_value engine fix already on this branch.
findings_summary: Read-only audit already complete (28 LGAs, 1001 rows). Existing extraction QA (schema validation migration 031, review queue migration 051, test_setback_taxonomy.py, verify_* scripts) checks STRUCTURE/CHANGE/ROUTING only — none verifies that an extracted setback value semantically matches its source clause, and the initial bulk load never passed the human review queue (queue only fires on changes). That is the exact hole Burwood front 9/15 (clauses P8/P39) fell through. The validator pure functions take already-fetched rows (dicts) — known schema: lga, control_type, value_min, value_max, unit, condition, source_text, section_ref, applicability, is_current. main() runs one read-only SELECT (no writes, no schema change, single table, WHERE is_current). Multi-signal so it is robust where any single signal is weak: (1) conflicting values with no distinguishing condition, (2) implausible magnitude, (3) strong foreign-control language with no setback language, (4) assumed/placeholder rows. Gemini is intentionally NOT used (deterministic-only rule); LLM triage is advisory-to-human only.
model_design: Pure functions in scripts/validate_dcp_setbacks.py: conflict_groups(rows), implausible_magnitude(rows), foreign_language(rows), placeholder_rows(rows), and audit_setback_controls(rows) combining them into a list of {lga, control_type, value, signal, detail}. main() pulls live rows via db_config and prints the statewide list, exit 1 if any. Offline unit tests (tests/test_dcp_setback_validation.py) lock each signal incl. the Burwood case and guard against false positives on legit tiered rows. A @pytest.mark.database ratchet test asserts the live flagged count does not exceed a recorded baseline so extraction can only get cleaner.
